quests.instruction: Identify the nature event that you feel blow softly against your face outside!
quests.question: Wind
quests.hint: This can make the leaves on a tree rustle and dance.
quests.explanation: Yes! Wind is correct because it is the moving air you feel blowing outside.
quests.funFact: Wind can be gentle like a breeze or strong enough to fly a kite!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature place that is full of many trees growing close together!
quests.question: Forest
quests.hint: This is a great place for a quiet walk under lots of shade.
quests.explanation: Great job! A Forest is correct because it is a place packed with many trees.
quests.funFact: Forests are home to more kinds of plants than almost any other place on Earth!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a calm pool of water surrounded by land!
quests.question: Lake
quests.hint: Unlike a river, this body of water does not flow anywhere.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Lake is correct because it is still water with land all around it.
quests.funFact: Some lakes are so big and deep that people call them inland seas!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a small, gentle rise in the land!
quests.question: Hill
quests.hint: It is much smaller and easier to climb than a mountain.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Hill is correct because it is a small rise in the land, smaller than a mountain.
quests.funFact: Rolling down a grassy hill is one of the oldest games kids have played!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that a new plant grows from!
quests.question: Seed
quests.hint: This tiny thing waits in the soil before it sprouts.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Seed is correct because a whole new plant grows from this tiny start.
quests.funFact: Some seeds can wait in the soil for years before they finally sprout!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that grows out from a tree's trunk!
quests.question: Branch
quests.hint: Birds often build nests here, high above the ground.
quests.explanation: Great job! A Branch is correct because it grows out from the trunk of a tree.
quests.funFact: Some tree branches can grow as long as a school bus!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a small pool of water left after it rains!
quests.question: Puddle
quests.hint: Kids love to jump in these while wearing rain boots.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Puddle is correct because it is a small pool of rainwater on the ground.
quests.funFact: A puddle usually dries up and disappears once the sun comes back out!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is water frozen hard and cold!
quests.question: Ice
quests.hint: This can make a sidewalk slippery in the winter.
quests.explanation: Yes! Ice is correct because it is water that has frozen solid.
quests.funFact: Ice floats on water because it is actually lighter than liquid water!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that shows many colors in a big curve across the sky!
quests.question: Rainbow
quests.hint: This often appears after rain, once the sun comes back out.
quests.explanation: Great job! A Rainbow is correct because it is a colorful curve that appears in the sky.
quests.funFact: A rainbow always has red on the outside and violet on the inside!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a low, thick cloud sitting near the ground!
quests.question: Fog
quests.hint: On mornings like this, it can be hard to see very far ahead.
quests.explanation: That's right! Fog is correct because it is a thick, cloudy mist close to the ground.
quests.funFact: Fog is really just a cloud that forms down near the ground instead of high in the sky!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature event that makes a big rumbling boom during a storm!
quests.question: Thunder
quests.hint: You usually hear this loud sound right after a bright flash in the sky.
quests.explanation: Yes! Thunder is correct because it is the loud rumbling sound heard during a storm.
quests.funFact: Thunder is actually the sound made by lightning heating the air super fast!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature event that flashes bright light across the sky during a storm!
quests.question: Lightning
quests.hint: This bright flash happens just before you hear a loud rumble.
quests.explanation: That's right! Lightning is correct because it is the bright flash of light seen during a storm.
quests.funFact: A single flash of lightning is hotter than the surface of the Sun!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a fallen tree lying on the forest floor!
quests.question: Log
quests.hint: Small animals often hide underneath this old, fallen piece of wood.
quests.explanation: Great choice! A Log is correct because it is a fallen tree trunk lying on the ground.
quests.funFact: An old log slowly turns into rich soil as it breaks down over many years!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is a small, calm pool of water, smaller than a lake!
quests.question: Pond
quests.hint: Lily pads often float on top of this quiet water.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Pond is correct because it is a small, calm pool of water.
quests.funFact: A pond is usually shallow enough that sunlight can reach all the way to the bottom!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature place that is a big, open area covered in grass or crops!
quests.question: Field
quests.hint: Farmers often grow their plants in a big, open place like this.
quests.explanation: Great job! A Field is correct because it is a big, open area of grass or growing crops.
quests.funFact: Some fields are so large that farmers need machines just to cross them!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature event that helps kites and sailboats move!
quests.question: Wind
quests.hint: You cannot see this, but you can hear it whistle around corners.
quests.explanation: That's right! Wind is correct because it pushes kites and sailboats along.
quests.funFact: The fastest winds on Earth happen inside giant spinning storms!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature place where you might get lost among tall trees!
quests.question: Forest
quests.hint: Many different plants and trees grow together in this big green place.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Forest is correct because it is a large area covered with growing trees.
quests.funFact: The biggest forest in the world is called the Amazon Rainforest!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object where people often go fishing or paddle a small boat!
quests.question: Lake
quests.hint: Ducks like to swim peacefully on this calm body of water.
quests.explanation: Well done! A Lake is correct because its calm water is perfect for paddling and fishing.
quests.funFact: The deepest lake in the world is Lake Baikal in Russia!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is easy to walk up in just a few minutes!
quests.question: Hill
quests.hint: From the top of this, you can often see a wide, pretty view.
quests.explanation: Great choice! A Hill is correct because it is a small, easy climb with a nice view on top.
quests.funFact: Some cities, like Rome, are famously built on top of several hills!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that is small enough to fit in the palm of your hand!
quests.question: Seed
quests.hint: Birds and squirrels love to snack on these tiny plant beginnings.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Seed is correct because it is a tiny object that grows into a plant.
quests.funFact: The tallest trees in the world all started from a single small seed!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that holds the leaves up on a tree!
quests.question: Branch
quests.hint: This can bend in strong wind without breaking.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Branch is correct because it holds up a tree's leaves.
quests.funFact: New branches grow a little bit longer every single year!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that shows your reflection after a rainy day!
quests.question: Puddle
quests.hint: This small, shallow pool forms in low spots on the sidewalk or ground.
quests.explanation: Well done! A Puddle is correct because you can see your reflection in its still water.
quests.funFact: Some puddles are home to tiny bugs for just a few days!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that melts back into water when it warms up!
quests.question: Ice
quests.hint: Skaters glide across a frozen pond covered in this.
quests.explanation: That's right! Ice is correct because it melts back into water in warmer weather.
quests.funFact: The biggest chunks of ice on Earth are called glaciers!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object made of sunlight shining through tiny raindrops!
quests.question: Rainbow
quests.hint: People say you cannot ever reach the end of this colorful arch.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Rainbow is correct because sunlight shining through raindrops creates its colors.
quests.funFact: You can sometimes see a rainbow in the spray of a garden hose!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that makes everything look soft and grey in the early morning!
quests.question: Fog
quests.hint: Drivers must go slowly and carefully when this covers the road.
quests.explanation: Well done! Fog is correct because its thick, grey mist makes things harder to see.
quests.funFact: Some coastal cities are famous for having foggy mornings almost all year round!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature event that can make windows rattle a little during a storm!
quests.question: Thunder
quests.hint: You can count the seconds after a flash to guess how far away this sound is.
quests.explanation: Great job! Thunder is correct because its loud boom can shake windows during a storm.
quests.funFact: Thunder can be heard from many miles away on a quiet night!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature event that lights up dark storm clouds for a split second!
quests.question: Lightning
quests.hint: This zig-zag flash travels faster than the sound that follows it.
quests.explanation: Yes! Lightning is correct because it lights up the sky in a quick, bright flash.
quests.funFact: Lightning can strike the same tall place, like a mountain top, many times!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object that you might sit on like a bench in the woods!
quests.question: Log
quests.hint: This round piece of wood once stood tall as part of a living tree.
quests.explanation: Well done! A Log is correct because it is a piece of tree trunk you can sit on.
quests.funFact: Some logs float and travel a long way down rivers before stopping!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature object found in a park, often with ducks swimming on it!
quests.question: Pond
quests.hint: This is much smaller than a lake, but just as calm and still.
quests.explanation: That's right! A Pond is correct because it is a small, still body of water, smaller than a lake.
quests.funFact: Ponds can freeze solid in winter and then thaw again every spring!

quests.instruction: Identify the nature place that is wide open with plenty of room to run!
quests.question: Field
quests.hint: This flat, grassy space stretches out with no trees blocking your view.
quests.explanation: Yes! A Field is correct because it is a wide-open, grassy space.
quests.funFact: A field left alone can slowly fill up with wildflowers all on its own!
